notes: Replaces the current bugherd-brand-vector.svg, which has no traceable source (derive finds none of its parts in BugHerd's own files: a reconstruction). BugHerd's only vector is the header wordmark. The circled 'BH.' favicon is only 32px, and bugherd-logo-round.png is the same circle at 80px, so this 256px file is the best. DECISION: on the dark theme the dark circle (87% of pixels) merges into the tile and the white wordmark floats alone; BugHerd publishes no version for dark backgrounds.
